info.title: Waifu API
info.description: REST API for browsing and fetching categorized anime images - images, tags, artists, albums and users, with filtering, pagination and authentication.

get.description: Returns all albums for the specified user. The default "Favorites" album is always listed first.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user ID or "me" for the current user.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Default: 30. Max: unlimited.

post.description: Create a new album to organize images. You can only create albums for yourself.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user ID or "me" (must be your own account).

get.description: Returns details for a specific album including image count.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user ID or "me".

parameters.name: albumId
parameters.description: The album ID or "favorites" for the default album.

patch.description: Update album name or description. You can only update your own albums.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user ID or "me".

parameters.name: albumId
parameters.description: The album ID or "favorites".

delete.description:
Permanently delete an album. The default "Favorites" album cannot be deleted.
Images in the album are NOT deleted, only removed from the album.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user ID or "me".

parameters.name: albumId
parameters.description: The album ID (cannot be "favorites").

get.description:
Returns images in the album with full filtering support.
Supports the same filters as the main images endpoint.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user ID or "me".

parameters.name: albumId
parameters.description: The album ID or "favorites".

parameters.name: IsNsfw
parameters.description: Filter by NSFW status. Default: false (SFW only).

parameters.name: IncludedTags
parameters.description: Only include images with ALL these tags (AND logic). Example: ?IncludedTags=waifu&IncludedTags=maid

parameters.name: ExcludedTags
parameters.description: Exclude images with ANY of these tags. Example: ?ExcludedTags=uniform&ExcludedTags=maid

parameters.name: IncludedArtists
parameters.description: Only include images by these artists (by ID, AND logic). Example: ?IncludedArtists=1

parameters.name: ExcludedArtists
parameters.description: Exclude images by these artists (by ID). Example: ?ExcludedArtists=1

parameters.name: IncludedIds
parameters.description: Only include these specific image IDs. Example: ?IncludedIds=8108&IncludedIds=8008

parameters.name: ExcludedIds
parameters.description: Exclude these specific image IDs. Example: ?ExcludedIds=8108

parameters.name: IsAnimated
parameters.description: Filter by animation status. Default: all.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: Sort order. Default: random. Note: AddedToAlbum only works on album images endpoint.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: Filter by image orientation. Default: all.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Default: 1. Max: unlimited.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Filter by width in pixels. Examples: 1920 (exact), >=1920 (min), <=1920 (max), 1280..1920 (range).

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: Filter by height in pixels. Examples: 1080 (exact), >=1080 (min), <=1080 (max), 720..1080 (range).

parameters.name: ByteSize
parameters.description: Filter by file size in bytes. Examples: 1000000 (exact), >=500000 (min), <=2000000 (max), 500000..2000000 (range).

parameters.name: UploaderId
parameters.description: Filter by uploader user ID (Moderator/Admin only).

parameters.name: ReviewStatus
parameters.description: Filter by review status (Moderator/Admin only). Default: Accepted.

parameters.name: ChildrenReviewStatus
parameters.description: Filter child entities (tags, artists) by review status (Moderator/Admin only). Default: Accepted.

parameters.name: IncludeMyPending
parameters.description:
Also include your own pending (not-yet-approved) uploads alongside the accepted images. Available to any
logged-in user (only ever surfaces your own pending content).

parameters.name: IncludeMyPendingChildren
parameters.description:
Also include your own pending (not-yet-approved) tags/artists on each returned image, alongside the
accepted ones. Available to any logged-in user.

post.summary: Add an image to an album.
post.description: Add an image to one of your albums. Use "favorites" as albumId to add to your favorites.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user ID or "me".

parameters.name: albumId
parameters.description: The album ID or "favorites".

parameters.name: imageId
parameters.description: The image ID to add.

delete.summary: Remove an image from an album.
delete.description: Remove an image from one of your albums. The image is not deleted, only unlinked from the album.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user ID or "me".

parameters.name: albumId
parameters.description: The album ID or "favorites".

parameters.name: imageId
parameters.description: The image ID to remove.

get.summary: List all artists with optional filtering.
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of artists. Use the `Name` parameter to search by artist name.
By default, only approved artists are returned.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Filter by artist name (partial match, case-insensitive). Example: ?Name=fourthwallzart

parameters.name: IncludedIds
parameters.description: Filter by specific artist IDs (exact match). Example: ?IncludedIds=1

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Default: 30. Max: unlimited.

parameters.name: ReviewStatus
parameters.description: Filter by review status (Moderator/Admin only). Default: Accepted.

parameters.name: IncludeMyPending
parameters.description:
Also include your own pending (not-yet-approved) artists alongside the accepted ones. Lets a logged-in user
see artists they created that are still awaiting review — e.g. to attach them in the upload/edit picker.

post.description:
Register a new artist in the database. Include their social media links if available.
The artist will be created with "Pending" review status and must be approved by a moderator.

403.description: Insufficient permissions (role restriction configured by API administrator).

409.description: An artist with this name already exists.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the artist.

patch.description:
Update an artist's name, social links, or review status.

**Requires:** Moderator role or higher.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The artist ID to update.

delete.description:
Permanently removes an artist. Images associated with this artist will no longer have this artist linked.

**Requires:** Admin role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The artist ID to delete.

get.description: Search for an artist by their exact name. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the artist.

post.description:
Exchange a Discord OAuth2 authorization code for a JWT token.

**Flow:**
1. Redirect user to Discord OAuth2 authorization URL
2. User authorizes the application
3. Discord redirects back with a `code` parameter
4. Send the code to this endpoint to get a JWT token

The JWT token should be included in subsequent requests as: `Authorization: Bearer {token}`

get.description:
Returns all API keys associated with your account.
For security, the key itself is never returned — only metadata (id, description, timestamps).

200.description: Returns the list of API keys.

post.description:
Generate a new API key for programmatic access to the API.

**Important:** The full API key is only shown once in the response. Store it securely.

Use the API key in requests as: `Authorization: ApiKey {your_key}`

patch.description:
Update the description or expiration date of an existing API key.
You cannot change the key itself - create a new one if needed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The API key ID to update.

404.description: API key not found or doesn't belong to you.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes an API key. Any requests using this key will be rejected immediately.
This action cannot be undone.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The API key ID to revoke.

404.description: API key not found or doesn't belong to you.

get.description: Returns the banner currently shown to visitors, or no content when there is none.

Returns the full banner configuration, including a disabled banner.

**Requires:** Moderator role or higher by default (configurable by the API administrator).

put.description:
Replaces the banner message, style and visibility.

**Requires:** Moderator role or higher by default (configurable by the API administrator).

get.summary: Get a specific image by ID.
get.description:
Returns detailed information about a single image including tags, artists, and metadata.
If authenticated, also includes user-specific data like favorite status.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the image.

parameters.name: childrenReviewStatus
parameters.description: Filter child entities (tags, artists) by review status (Moderator/Admin only). Default: Accepted.

parameters.name: includeMyPendingChildren
parameters.description: Also include your own pending (not-yet-approved) tags/artists on the image, alongside the accepted ones. Available to any logged-in user.

patch.description:
Update image metadata such as tags, artists, source URL, or NSFW status.
Moderators can also update the review status and reassign the uploader.
Optionally, the image file itself can be replaced.

**Requires:** Moderator role or higher.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The image ID to update.

delete.description:
Permanently removes an image from the gallery and storage.
This action cannot be undone.

**Requires:** Admin role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The image ID to delete.

post.description:
Upload an image file to the gallery. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP.

The image will be processed to extract metadata (dimensions, dominant color, perceptual hash).
New images are set to "Pending" review status and must be approved by a moderator before appearing in public searches.

**Size limits:**
- Maximum file size: configurable via `Image:MaxUploadSizeMb` (default: 10MB)
- Minimum dimensions: configured per server

requestBody.description: Whether this image contains NSFW (Not Safe For Work) content.

403.description: Insufficient permissions (role restriction configured by API administrator).

get.summary: Check that the API is up.
get.description:
Returns the plain text body `pong` as soon as the request reaches the API.
No authentication required.

head.summary: Check that the API is up.
head.description:
Returns the plain text body `pong` as soon as the request reaches the API.
No authentication required.

post.description:
Submit a report for an image that violates guidelines or contains inappropriate content.
Please provide a clear description of the issue to help moderators review the report efficiently.

**Common report reasons:**
- Wrong tags (e.g., marked as SFW but contains NSFW content)
- Copyright violation
- Duplicate image
- Low quality or inappropriate content

requestBody.description: The report details including image ID and description.

409.description: You already have a pending report for this image.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of image reports. Use the `Status` filter to show a single lifecycle status
(Pending, Resolved, Rejected, Cancelled).

Moderators see all reports; regular users only ever see their own. A moderator can pass `mine=true`
to see just their own reports (their "My Reports" view).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filter by lifecycle status (Pending, Resolved, Rejected, Cancelled).

parameters.name: Mine
parameters.description: Moderators only: return just your own reports instead of everyone's. (Non-moderators are always scoped to their own.)

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page.

patch.description:
Update the description of a report you submitted. Only allowed while the report is still open
(not yet resolved). Moderators may edit any open report.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The report ID to edit.

patch.description: The report was legitimate and has been handled. **Requires:** Moderator role or higher.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The report ID.

requestBody.description: Optional moderator note shown to the reporter.

patch.description: The report was not valid and has been dismissed. **Requires:** Moderator role or higher.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The report ID.

requestBody.description: Optional moderator note shown to the reporter.

patch.description: The report's author withdraws it. Moderators may cancel any report. Only pending reports can be cancelled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The report ID.

post.summary: Submit a proposed edit to an existing image, tag or artist.
post.description:
The `payload` contains only the fields you want to change (its shape depends on `targetType`).
Unknown fields are rejected. You may only have one pending edit per item.

201.description: Edit submitted (or applied immediately for trusted users).

400.description: Invalid payload or no effective change.

409.description: You already have a pending edit for this item, or the open-edit limit was reached.

get.description:
Moderators see all tasks and can filter freely. Regular users only ever see their own
(the `mine` flag is implied for them) — this is their "my submissions / my suggestions" view.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filter by status (e.g. Pending). Default: all.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.description: Filter by kind (NewContent or Edit).

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description: Filter by target type.

parameters.name: TargetId
parameters.description: Filter by a specific target id.

parameters.name: Mine
parameters.description: Moderators only: restrict the results to your own submissions.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Default: .

get.summary: Get a single review task by ID.

404.description: Review task not found (or not yours).

patch.summary: Edit a pending task's content — the submitted entity (NewContent) or the proposed change (Edit).
patch.description:
Allowed for the original submitter (their own task) or any moderator, and only while the task is Pending.
Content-only: it never changes review status (use Approve/Reject for that). When a moderator edits
someone else's submission, it is flagged so the submitter sees a "modified by a moderator" cue.

409.description: The task has already been resolved.

patch.summary: Approve a review task (publish new content, or apply a proposed edit).
patch.description: **Requires:** Moderator role or higher. For edits, the proposed values simply overwrite the current ones.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The review task ID.

404.description: Task or its target not found.

patch.summary: Reject a review task (delete the submitted content, or decline a proposed edit).

Cancel a review task. The original submitter (while pending) or a moderator may cancel.
Cancelling a new submission withdraws (deletes) it.

403.description: You can only cancel your own submissions.

get.description: Returns: total requests, total images, total tags, total artists.

Returns detailed request statistics: requests today, daily history (last year),
top users by requests, authenticated vs unauthenticated breakdown,
API key vs JWT breakdown, plus all public stats.

**Requires:** Admin role.

get.summary: Get storage diff between S3 and database.
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of discrepancies between S3 storage and the database.

**Modes:**
- `OrphansInS3`: Files that exist in S3 but have no matching database record.
- `MissingFromS3`: Database records whose files are missing from S3.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: The diff mode: OrphansInS3 (files in S3 without DB record) or MissingFromS3 (DB records without S3 file).

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Default: 30. Max: unlimited.

delete.description:
Removes one or more files from S3 storage that have no corresponding database record.
Use this to clean up orphaned files found via the `OrphansInS3` diff mode.

delete.summary: Delete database records for images missing from S3.
delete.description:
Removes one or more image records from the database whose files no longer exist in S3.
Use this to clean up orphaned database entries found via the `MissingFromS3` diff mode.
No S3 deletion is performed since the files are already absent.

parameters.name: IncludedIds

parameters.name: IncludedSlugs

parameters.name: IncludeMyPending

Also include your own pending (not-yet-approved) tags alongside the accepted ones. Lets a logged-in user

post.description:
Creates a new tag for categorizing images.
The tag will be created with "Pending" review status and must be approved by a moderator.

If no slug is provided, one will be automatically generated from the name.

403.description: Insufficient permissions (role restriction configured by API administrator).

409.description: A tag with this name or slug already exists.

get.summary: Get a tag by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tag.

patch.description:
Update a tag's name, description, slug, or review status.

**Requires:** Moderator role or higher.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The tag ID to update.

delete.description:
Permanently removes a tag. Images that had this tag will no longer be associated with it.

**Requires:** Admin role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The tag ID to delete.

get.summary: Get a tag by its slug.
get.description:
Slugs are URL-friendly identifiers (e.g., "waifu", "marin-kitagawa").
This endpoint is useful when you know the tag slug but not its ID.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The URL-friendly slug of the tag.

get.description: Returns the profile information for the currently authenticated user.

Resolves the server-configured role requirements against your role, so clients know which
restricted features (e.g. editing the site banner) to offer.

Returns minimal user information. Used by moderators for content review.

**Requires:** Moderator role or higher.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user ID.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of all users with their full profiles.

**Requires:** Admin role.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Default: 30. Max: unlimited.

put.description:
Update a user's role to grant or revoke permissions.
You cannot change your own role.

**Requires:** Admin role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user ID to update.

400.description: Invalid role or trying to change own role.

put.description:
Banned users cannot authenticate or use the API.
Their existing API keys will be rejected.

**Requires:** Admin role.
